title: Gas Plan Uplift Rate Card for Restored Dual-Fuel Credits, Residential Electricity Supply
content:
When a missed dual-fuel credit is restored on a Residential Electricity Supply agreement, an uplift is added to the per-cycle dual-fuel credit according to the gas plan held on the same premise under Residential Natural Gas Supply.

| Gas agreement on the same premise | Uplift added to the per-cycle dual-fuel credit |
|---|---|
| On a fixed-rate gas plan whose term is 24 months or longer | 2.00 USD (long-term bundle uplift) |
| On a fixed-rate gas plan whose term is shorter than 24 months | 1.00 USD (short-term bundle uplift) |
| On any gas plan that is not fixed-rate, or no gas plan on the premise | nothing |

**Reading the gas records.** The tier is decided from the rate type and the term in months of the gas plan recorded on the customer's Residential Natural Gas Supply agreement at the same premise. Both parts of the first two rows must hold together: a fixed-rate plan, and a term on the right side of 24 months.

**Boundary of the term.** A fixed-rate gas plan with a 24-month term takes the 2.00 USD uplift; one with a 23-month or 12-month term takes the 1.00 USD uplift. A gas plan whose pricing is not fixed-rate adds nothing, whatever its term.

| Gas plan (hypothetical) | Fixed-rate | Term (months) | Uplift |
|---|---|---|---|
| fixed, 36 months | yes | 36 | 2.00 USD |
| fixed, 24 months | yes | 24 | 2.00 USD |
| fixed, 12 months | yes | 12 | 1.00 USD |
| not fixed-rate, 12 months | no | 12 | nothing |
| month-to-month variable | no | 0 | nothing |
